# Kenney Car Kit — downloaded, not used in the game

CC0 (public domain), https://kenney.nl/assets/car-kit, downloaded 2026-07-28.

Kept because it was asked for and because the debris models (bolts, tyres,
bumpers, door panels) are genuinely useful as wreckage props later. The
*vehicles* are not used: the kit is ambulances, fire engines, garbage trucks,
police cars and five go-karts — no military vehicle in the set — and Kenney's
house style is rounded and brightly coloured, which reads as a toy next to a
HECU rifleman. Dropping them in would have made the game look less real, not
more.

The trucks, APC and tank the game actually uses are generated by
Tools/blender/build_vehicles.py for that reason.
